check_links: check all internal links in a documentation folder for broken markdown and mdx references
check_links_cli: run the CLI link checker on a documentation folder and print a summary of broken links
check_file_links: check all internal links in a single markdown or mdx file and return broken link details
resolve_link_path: resolve a relative markdown link URL to an absolute file path from a source file
find_target_file: find the target file for a link, handling missing .md or .mdx extensions
